case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 738 OF 2023 (@ SLP(CRL.) NO.9665 OF 2017)

parties.respondent: The State Of Uttar Pradesh & ANR.

summary: Summons under Section 319 CrPC vs standard for summoning additional accused; parameters: discretion; extraordinary power; strong/cogent evidence required; near-probability of complicity standard; beyond prima facie for framing charges; mere supply of illegible bank statement insufficient to establish nexus; appellant's role irrelevant to fraudulent withdrawals; appeal allowed; dismissal of application for summoning upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order set aside; application for summoning appellant as additional accused dismissed.
